_comment: Presentation labels are editorial summaries of data/profile.json, not testimonials or new product claims. Images are real repository app icons/social previews, not UI screenshots. Upstream provenance is recorded per project.

cascade-v3.title: Cascade
cascade-v3.summary: One idea. Five verified contracts. A spec-driven architecture engine for turning ambiguity into agent-ready software plans.

whisper-bar.title: WhisperBar
whisper-bar.summary: Speak, don’t type. Native menu-bar dictation that brings voice input to any application on your Mac.

nodaysidle-sonora.title: Sonora
nodaysidle-sonora.summary: Your music, without the weight. A native desktop player bringing local audio, Spotify, and YouTube Music together.

synapse-notes.title: Synapse Notes
synapse-notes.summary: From voice to connected knowledge. Capture thoughts, transcribe notes, and explore ideas in a three-dimensional graph.

nodaysidle-browser.title: NODAYSIDLE Browser
nodaysidle-browser.summary: A quieter way to browse. A focused Swift and WebKit browser with local-first persistence and no background analytics.

nodaysrammar.title: nodaysrammar
nodaysrammar.summary: Private grammar checks, on your machine. English, Italian, and Slovenian — offline, no telemetry, sideload only.

kurek.title: Kurek
kurek.summary: A voice assistant for Arch and Hyprland. Middle-click, speak, and it acts — with your own DeepSeek and xAI keys.

shareguard.title: ShareGuard
shareguard.summary: A last look before you share. Local macOS scanning for secrets, contacts, and risky paths — no network calls.

nodaysidle-browser-linux.title: NODAYSIDLE Browser for Linux
nodaysidle-browser-linux.summary: A quieter way to browse on Linux. Rust, GTK 3, and WebKitGTK in a 1.5 MB AppImage — no Electron, no telemetry.
